note: Causal SDPA over two 64-wide heads, the o_proj over the merged heads, and the residual add, as one kernel: the o_proj's A operand is the attention output normalized by its own row sum, a computed cone that reads the softmax fold through two edges. With a tensor-core o_proj on the `d2/smem` compute fill, the fill replicated both lowerings of that fold per cell and nvcc refused the kernel (`acc3__c3 has already been declared`) on every card; the prefill SDPA + o_proj + residual target of the golden-bench corpus had no realizable row for that reason (plans/h100-memo-2026-09-10.md, item 5). The seam now lowers the fold once.

let f32 v0 = 0.125
in0 = load scaled_dot_product_attention_mask_fill_c[0]
in1 = load scaled_dot_product_attention_mask_zero_c[0]
for a0 in 0..64:
    for a1 in 0..128:
        for a2 in 0..128:
            for a3 in 0..64:
                for a4 in 0..64:
                    in2 = load x0[0, a2 / 64, a0, a4]
                    in3 = load x1[0, a2 / 64, a3, a4]
                    f32 v1 = multiply(in2, in3)
                    acc2 <- add(acc2, v1) over a4
                v2 = multiply(acc2, v0)
                v3 = select:
                    in1 when a3 <= a0
                    in0 when a0 < a3
                v4 = add(v2, v3)
                acc1 <- maximum(acc1, v4) over a3
            for a3 in 0..64:
                for a6 in 0..64:
                    in4 = load x0[0, a2 / 64, a0, a6]
                    in5 = load x1[0, a2 / 64, a3, a6]
                    f32 v5 = multiply(in4, in5)
                    acc4 <- add(acc4, v5) over a6
                v6 = multiply(acc4, v0)
                v7 = select:
                    in1 when a3 <= a0
                    in0 when a0 < a3
                v8 = add(v6, v7)
                v9 = subtract(v8, acc1)
                v10 = exp(v9)
                acc3 <- add(acc3, v10) over a3
            for a3 in 0..64:
                for a8 in 0..64:
                    in6 = load x0[0, a2 / 64, a0, a8]
                    in7 = load x1[0, a2 / 64, a3, a8]
                    f32 v11 = multiply(in6, in7)
                    acc6 <- add(acc6, v11) over a8
                v12 = multiply(acc6, v0)
                in8 = load x2[0, a2 / 64, a3, a2 % 64]
                v13 = select:
                    in1 when a3 <= a0
                    in0 when a0 < a3
                v14 = add(v12, v13)
                v15 = subtract(v14, acc1)
                v16 = exp(v15)
                v17 = divide(v16, acc3)
                v18 = multiply(in8, v17)
                acc5 <- add(acc5, v18) over a3
            f16 v19 = copy(acc5)
            in9 = load x3[a1, a2]
            f32 v20 = multiply(in9, v19)
            acc0 <- add(acc0, v20) over a2
        f16 v21 = copy(acc0)
        in10 = load x4[0, a0, a1]
        v22 = add(in10, v21)
        add[0, a0, a1] = v22
